purpose: Checks EU CRA Annex I Part I essential cybersecurity requirements: sbom_present, sbom_machine_readable, top_level_deps_covered, vuln_handling_policy_present, secure_by_default, and a valid conformity_route (self_assessment | eu_type_examination | full_quality_assurance). Emits annex1_complete verdict and ordered gap list with PDF export. Middle stage of cra-product-conformance chain.
